title: Literature Search Strategy
intent: formative · Research & Retrieval (Doing) · click through the process
statement: Find the right sources efficiently and ethically — by searching deliberately, not by scrolling.

steps.title: Break the question into concepts
steps.text: Pull out the two or three core ideas your search must combine.

steps.title: Build search strings
steps.text: Combine synonyms with OR, concepts with AND, and exclude noise with NOT.

steps.title: Search the right databases
steps.text: Choose subject databases and scholarly indexes, not just a general web search.

steps.title: Screen and refine
steps.text: Scan titles and abstracts, then tighten keywords and filters based on what you find.

steps.title: Track and cite what you keep
steps.text: Record the searches and save references as you go, so the work is reproducible.

feedForward.text: Write one Boolean string for your topic using AND, OR and NOT, then name the database you would run it in.
